name: Views Accordion
description: Provides an accordion views display plugin.
project_description:
Views Accordion provides a display style plugin for the Views module.

It will take the results and display them as a JQuery accordion , using the first field as the header for the accordion rows.

 The module integrates the jQuery UI Accordion plugin as a views style plugin. You can configure the options provided by the jQuery UI plugin. 

 Features 
 
 Works with field grouping and relationships. 
 Option to use the field grouping headers as the headers for the accordion items. (yay!) 
 Configure settings for jQuery UI Accordion through the views interface. 
 
 Using jQuery UI themes 
 The recommended approach is to use jqueryui_theme module, though it is only available for Drupal 7. See [#2417233]

 Note that the documentation and advanced help pages need some love, patches are welcome!

 Development status and future plans 
 Drupal 7 : Only bug fixes and the occasional feature if the community provides it.

 Drupal 8 : Is now stable and in maintenance mode only. Core now ships with jQuery UI 1.11 so only the options on this release are supported.

 Drupal 9 : Is now supported, on the 2.0.x branch and forward. jQuery UI was removed from core, so the module now requires the jQuery UI Accordion contrib.

 How to help development of this module:

 
 Documenting this module, either providing patches for advanced help pages, or updating the documentation page 
 Report any bugs you may find. Please search the issue queue before you do, and read this first to save us all time and headaches ;) 
 Fill in feature requests that would be reasonable, include a patch if you can! 
 Buy the author a coffee to keep him motivated.
